capture: The four hook payloads were captured from the installed program in print mode (claude -p --model haiku), with a project-level hook in .claude/settings.local.json that copied its stdin to a file. Every session id, prompt id, path and cwd is a placeholder. The real transcript_path names a file under the user Claude folder; the placeholder does not repeat that folder, and no code opens the file.

UserPromptSubmit.prompt: Reply with the single word ok.

hook_notes: No hook payload holds a context percent. The percent comes only from the status line payload.
SessionStart also fires after a compact, with source "compact". That payload adds prompt_id and model to the fields above.
The compact command in print mode fires PreCompact and a SessionStart with source "compact". It fires neither UserPromptSubmit nor Stop, because it is a local command with no model turn.

The hook sees FACTORY_HOME and FACTORY_SESSION from the environment of the claude process. A hook in the .claude folder of a subfolder of a git repository and in the .claude folder of a git worktree both fired.

statusline.source: field names from the devflow HUD, which reads the live payload; checked against the Claude Code status line docs (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline)
notes: Print mode draws no status line, so this payload is built from the field names. The values are made up. An interactive capture replaces it.
context_window.used_percentage can be null early in a session. context_window.current_usage is null before the first API call and again after a compact, until the next API call.
used_percentage counts input tokens only: input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens, divided by context_window_size.
rate_limits is present only for claude.ai subscribers, and only after the first API response. Each window (five_hour, seven_day) can be absent on its own.
